expectations.text: Issue body does NOT carry the user's implementation suggestions: no 'add a route in api2', no 'copy the items-list export button component'

expectations.text: Issue body contains at least one Given/When/Then scenario
expectations.evidence: One scenario: 'Finding the export without prior knowledge' with full Given/When/Then.

expectations.text: Issue body has a Missing tests section listing at least one named test
expectations.evidence: Two named tests: export control's purpose evident without hover (component); find-and-complete export end-to-end with CSV download verification (e2e).

expectations.text: Missing tests section explicitly instructs: add the test, watch it fail, then make it pass (red before green)
expectations.evidence: 'For each one, in order: add the test, run it, watch it fail for the right reason, then write whatever makes it pass. Do not start implementation before the failing test exists.'

expectations.text: A Done-when / definition of done ties completion to the listed tests passing
expectations.evidence: 'Done when: Every test above exists and passes, every scenario holds, and the requester confirms the export — now that it can be found — covers the need behind the original request.'

claims.evidence: git log confirms da5076b0 'feat(scorecard): add CSV export matching old site'. The baseline run independently reached the same conclusion.

claims.evidence: Consistent with the baseline run's independent finding (legacy ERB link), but not separately verified in this grading pass.

suggestions.reason: The eval's premise (feature missing) turned out false in the real repo — both runs detected the export already exists. The eval still discriminated well, but a future iteration could use a verified-missing feature for a cleaner test of speccing net-new behavior.

eval_feedback.overall: Best-case skill behavior: verify-the-gap caught a false premise, the issue was respecced as the real (discoverability) gap, and the implementation bait was excluded with documented reasoning.
